rationale: The assistant explained 4C as a water supply error, and when the customer found the closed isolation valve it confirmed that opening it was the fix. This led to the dishwasher filling and running, with no part recommended. The first reply was somewhat long and put the mesh filter step ahead of the simpler valve check, although it did say to switch the machine off and isolate the water first. The conclusion that the plumber left the valve closed is a reasonable inference from the customer's account rather than an invented fact.
